page.notes: Hebrew and Latin of the lexicon entries are copied as seen. The lower section is set in smaller type; the Hebrew vowel points in the lower entries are faint and some are doubtful. Right margin and speckling show ink and paper damage; no marginal notes are printed. Several Hebrew vowel points in the upper entries (e.g. קָטַל, קִיתְרוֹס, קִרְיָדוֹן) are uncertain and not marked with [?] because they were read from a degraded scan at reduced size and should be checked against the original.
